solutions.title: Bitmask enumeration
solutions.strategy: Use each bit pattern from 0 to 2^n - 1 as the inclusion mask for one subset.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are 2^n masks and each can inspect n positions.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output contains 2^n subsets with up to n values each.

solutions.title: Backtracking include/exclude
solutions.strategy: Walk the array once, recursively choosing whether each value is absent or present in the current subset.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each subset copy can contain up to n values.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output dominates; the decision path uses O(n) extra stack space.
